text:
## 4. Note for franchise owners

Goes out a week before the owners' email, so franchise offices hear it from us first; owners on a franchise account get section 1 after their franchise has.

**To:** franchise owners who resell Acme Dispatch
**Subject:** New for your franchise offices: every customer text, kept on the job card

Hi [First name],

You're hearing this a week before your owners do. From [date], owners on Acme Dispatch can text, call and email customers from the job card, with texting from the owner's own number as each one clears registration.

What it means for your offices:
- A job can now carry the customer's texts, call notes and emails, so your office sees what the customer asked next to the quote.
- Quotes that stall after the visit are revenue your franchise never sees. Now the follow-up sits on the job [and Crew Activity shows which quotes got one].
- Nothing changes in the tools you give your owners today. [You decide whether calling and texting are switched on for each office's account, and who pays for them.]

For your office staff: texts go only to customers who've opted in, [from a number registered in the owner's own name]; a STOP reply ends texting on its own; [call recording follows the rule your state sets]; [every message is kept on the job card]. [Customer conversations are never shared with other companies.]

Your owners' launch email goes out on [date]. Want it to come from you? [We'll send it co-signed by [franchise name], or give you the copy to send under your own name.] Or book a 20-minute walkthrough for your office: **[Book a time]**

Best,
Acme Dispatch Team
